body:
### Goal

Wire the voltgo controller into configuration and application bootstrap.

### Approach

- `internal/config/config.go`: add `Voltgo voltgo.Configuration` (yaml tag `voltgo`) to `SolarControllerConfiguration`, with validation (address required when enabled, `publishPeriod` > 0)
- `internal/app/app.go` `buildControllers`: construct the voltgo controller from config, append when `Enabled()`
- Extend `config_test.go` and `app_test.go` table cases (disabled, enabled-no-address, enabled valid)

---
